Character codes index this 256-byte flag table. The engine copies the selected byte to $19 in its tile sampler at $247D.
One colour value for each character code. The room renderer at $520E looks up the character it just wrote to screen RAM before writing the corresponding colour cell.
Values indexed by the hardware sprite pointer. The object sprite staging routine at $2DC8 copies the selected colour into its zero-page hardware update table.

Eight groups of four frames, with eight character rows in each frame. The updater at $1EA8 cycles the group every call and advances the frame after visiting the eighth group. It writes the selected rows into the character graphics at $EFD8–$EFFF.

This level reserves 13 eight-byte room descriptors before the first pointed-to list. The first big-endian pair offsets into the metatile map at $8A00. Byte three, counted from zero, contributes the right scroll limit. The last two pairs point to exits and objects relative to $A400.

Little-endian pointers. The first word points to the picture directory. Subsequent words select the entry and ending command streams for the level.

Command stream 0 for $454F. The dispatcher uses the first byte of each record. Commands select pictures, write $FF-terminated lines of text, position sprites and hold the scene. Zero returns from the drawing routine.

Command stream 1 for $454F. The dispatcher uses the first byte of each record. Commands select pictures, write $FF-terminated lines of text, position sprites and hold the scene. Zero returns from the drawing routine.
Story sprite frame sequence. Values below $FE select shapes, $FE holds a shape for the specified duration, and $FF rewinds the stream by a word offset. This span occupies $AD84–$ADAB.
Story sprite motion sequence. A normal pair combines an update count with two signed motion nibbles. A zero command takes a little-endian continuation address. This span occupies $ADAC–$ADB8.
Story sprite frame sequence. Values below $FE select shapes, $FE holds a shape for the specified duration, and $FF rewinds the stream by a word offset. This span occupies $ADB9–$ADF8.
Little-endian picture addresses. The picture command subtracts one from its picture number to select the entry.
Header of story picture 1. The draw command starts eight bytes past this address. The stored dimensions are 32 columns by 20 rows.
Story picture 1 character matrix starting at row 0. The copier advances the source by 32 and the destination by 40 after each row, looking up display colours per character.
Story picture 1 character matrix starting at row 16. The copier advances the source by 32 and the destination by 40 after each row, looking up display colours per character.

68 little-endian object template addresses. The engine patches its indexed load operand from the level setup table at $86B2. Consecutive distinct targets advance seven or eleven bytes across the records. Some indices share a target.
